scope: Initial behavior ledger. Passing this manifest covers only its named cases on the recorded platform and architecture; it does not establish complete runtime parity.

static_reference.coverage: Selected shipped JavaScript wrappers only; no execution or native-helper equivalence was established. Versions identify evidence, never select compatible installed apps.

unified_facade_reference.coverage: Five selected shipped JavaScript modules and package metadata; 466 files remain unselected. Static analysis does not establish native helper behavior or runtime execution.

cases.scenario: Open two independently observed fixture windows in one process; target exactly one and enter text.
Close a bound window, then attempt input through its old handle while a sibling remains.
Remove the observed control and replace its ordinal with another control without refreshing the observation; act on the old index.
Type ASCII, Korean, emoji and combining marks, followed by Tab and Return in fields that report focus and submit events.
Type literal text ending in protocol-looking delimiters and read the complete field value independently.
Deliver modifier chords and then an unmodified key; inspect both field effects and remaining modifier state.
Exercise element and screenshot-coordinate clicks, supported buttons and click counts against independent event counters.
Capture a scaled window, move it and change its size before coordinate input; inspect refusal or exact recipient without coordinate reinterpretation.
Compare AX-only, screenshot-only and combined observations of the same stable fixture state, including window frame and image scale.
Select an exact substring and inspect selection/caret, or observe the platform's supported refusal.

static_expectation.linux: The inspected unified facade refuses selectText.
static_expectation.windows: The inspected unified facade refuses selectText.
static_expectation.macos: Forwarded to the native helper; detailed selection behavior needs live evidence.

cases.scenario: Try repeated and overlapping substrings, prefix/suffix disambiguation and cursor-before/after around a non-BMP character, including platform refusals.
Set an indexed editable value and inspect change events, or observe the platform's supported refusal.

static_expectation.linux: The inspected unified facade refuses setValue.

cases.scenario: Paste plain text into an existing selection while the clipboard holds several fixture formats; inspect inserted text and clipboard restoration.
Request HTML and Markdown paste, including default format, and inspect styling/text or an explicit platform refusal.

static_expectation.linux: The inspected unified facade accepts text-only paste.
static_expectation.windows: The inspected unified facade accepts text-only paste.

cases.scenario: Replace selected text with identical text; distinguish successful dispatch from a no-op or uncertainty without replay.
During paste, let the fixture take clipboard ownership, including a same-content copy; verify the newer copy survives cleanup.
Request page and pixel scrolling at a point; inspect actual scroll offsets and platform-specific refusals.

static_expectation.linux: The inspected unified facade requires pixel distance and refuses page distance.
static_expectation.macos: The inspected unified facade accepts page distance and refuses pixel distance.
static_expectation.windows: The inspected unified facade requires point plus pixel distance.

cases.scenario: Scroll an observed container, replace it without refreshing observation, then reuse the old index; inspect replacement and sibling offsets or platform refusal.

static_expectation.windows: The inspected unified facade refuses indexed scrolling.

cases.scenario: Drag between captured window points, then interrupt a second drag; inspect recipient path, final position and released buttons.
Invoke an advertised secondary action and interact with a modal while the parent and another window remain visible.
Launch a fixture app from current inventory, including an ambiguous or removed inventory entry; inspect process/window ownership.
Navigate an owned fixture tab to approved and refused exact origins, including a redirect; observe requests independently at each server.
Read AX, type Unicode into a form, click Submit and capture the tab; inspect server payload and capture geometry.
Act in same-origin and cross-origin frames and shadow/slot content; replace a frame and retry its old node index.
Bind a fixture user tab through a mention and exact profile identity, then change or remove the claimed target.
Create temporary and explicitly kept fixture tabs, finish or interrupt the owning turn and inspect tabs independently.
Create a fixture tab with visibility and session-name options; observe presentation/ownership or exact provider refusal.
Retain variables across calls, use two independent sessions, reset one and retry its old handles.
Cancel while a fixture blocks a pre-dispatch accessibility lookup, release that lookup, and observe whether any subsequent input is delivered.
Break the task-owned helper connection after native dispatch; recover or reset and verify the uncertain operation is never replayed.
Allow one fixture app, attempt a second, revoke the first and reuse its retained handle; preserve caller sandbox and approval settings.
Request host Stop for one fixture app, retry within that turn and in a new turn; inspect per-app state and persisted grant.
Exercise default-off audio refusal and explicit opt-in with a generated fixture tone; inspect approval, WAV structure and decoded samples.
